Support

Common fixes first; how to reach us at the bottom.

Friend cards

  1. Link didn't openCopy the complete link, open CruiseMesh, choose Add a friend, and paste it.
  2. Card looks incompleteSome messaging apps cut long links short. Copy your friend's whole message and paste it on the page the link opens, or into Add a friend in CruiseMesh. A complete card includes text beginning with CMFRIEND after the #.
  3. Confirm the personCompare the four fingerprint words on both phones before messaging.

Shore Pass setup

Shore Pass was called Cruise Pass until August 2026. If your purchase email, your receipt, or the Settings screen on your phone says Cruise Pass, it's the same pass and everything below applies. The screen is renamed in a later app update, so a phone that hasn't updated still shows the old name.

  1. Setup link didn't openCopy the CMRELAY1 card from your purchase email. In CruiseMesh, open Settings → Shore Pass, paste it, choose Review, then Test and use.
  2. Card looks incompleteCopy the full setup link or all text beginning with CMRELAY1:. An incomplete card is rejected before saved settings can change.
  3. Phone is offlineAfter reviewing the card, choose Save and check later. CruiseMesh will verify it when the phone is online and will not show Ready before then.
  4. Setup card rejectedReplace the card with the one from your latest purchase email. If that card is also rejected, contact support without posting the card or token.
  5. Pass expired or suspendedCruiseMesh shows these separately from a connection outage. Renew an expired pass, or contact support for a suspended pass.
  6. Set up another family phoneOpen Settings → Shore Pass on a configured phone, then choose Set up another phone or Show setup QR. This configures internet delivery; it does not add a contact.
  7. Shore Pass not syncingOpen Settings → Shore Pass to see whether the pass is working, waiting for internet, expired, suspended, or needs attention. The syncing phone needs internet access — on a ship, that's usually one phone with a Wi-Fi package.
  8. Need technical detailOpen Connection details from the home screen menu to see active paths, per-person history, recent activity, and the Share diagnostics option.

Purchases and refunds

  1. Lost your setup linkIt's in the email from your purchase. Can't find it? Contact us and we'll re-send it.
  2. Charged but nothing arrivedActivation normally takes under a minute. If it's been longer, contact us with your checkout email address.
  3. Want a refundNo questions asked. Contact us with your checkout email address within 90 days of purchase and we'll refund the full amount.

Contact

Email support@cruisemesh.app. For purchase issues, include the email address you used at checkout. Your setup card is your family's secret. We never need it, so don't send it to us or post it anywhere.
